actions.test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
actions.message: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total の assertion error が 10回連続。最優先で対処。

details.estimated_root_cause: Coupon success UI is shown, but total stays at ¥418 instead of applying the expected 10% discount to ¥380.
details.recommended_action: Fix discount calculation or total recomputation when coupon is applied; verify subtotal/rounding logic.
